ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $3.12 voucher (RydeTAXI metered-distance overcharge for the unexempted detour) and record a RD-1 route-obligation violation on the driver's file; no account flag (no upheld route dispute in 90 days).

segment_findings.reason: RD-5 not met: driver proposed the Outram Road detour at 18:28 [F7] but the rider never replied [F7][F8/complaint], i.e. no affirmative agreement before the deviation. RD-4 not met: the driver's claimed cause (Kampong Bahru congestion) is unsupported — F11 records no incidents and F9/F10 are band 3 (not band 1/2) and not on the substituted optimal segment. RD-3(a) not applicable (no passenger-named stop). Hence unexempted; refund = 2.21 km × ($15.33/10.9 km) = $3.12 under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement of implied consent contradicts the chat record [F7] (no rider reply) and the rider's complaint; under RD-5 consent must be affirmative and given before the deviation — driver statements do not override the chat/timeline record.
The full $4.21 billed excess is based on the +3.0 km trip-level difference; RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra_km (2.21 km), so the map-matching/other residual is not refunded.
Flagging requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; the driver profile [F14] shows 0 upheld route disputes, so no flag_account.
